description: WhatsApp on Monday announced that it is now allowing users to reserve their usernames on the instant messaging platform, in preparation for the upcoming feature, which will allow you to search for other known and unknown WhatsApp users, bringing the instant messaging platform closer to how other social media platforms, like Instagram, function. Confirmed to roll out soon, the feature will eliminate the need for you to share phone numbers with other users to allow them to contact you via WhatsApp. You will be able to simply share your usernames with others, and they will then be able to search for you within the app. However, if you do not want everyone to contact you, you can choose to set a unique username key. Others will not be able to contact you if they do not have this key.
title: How to Reserve Your Username on WhatsApp: A Step-By-Step Guide

description: Moto Buds 2 was recently launched in India at an affordable price of Rs. 2,999. The new true wireless stereo (TWS) features 11mm dynamic drivers in each earbud. However, with the long battery life and great in-ear comfort, the Moto Buds 2 could be worn for hours.
title: Moto Buds 2 Review: How Much Bass Is Too Much Bass?

description: LPDDR5X is the latest mobile memory standard used in many flagship and premium mid-range smartphones. It offers faster data transfer speeds and better power efficiency than LPDDR5 and LPDDR4X, helping improve gaming, multitasking, AI-powered features, and other demanding tasks. However, RAM is only one part of a phone's performance. The processor, storage, software optimisation, and cooling system also affect the user experience, making LPDDR5X an important upgrade but not the sole factor to consider when buying a smartphone.
title: What Is LPDDR5X RAM in Phones and Does It Actually Matter?
